text: {"name":"rf_tx_power_temperature_comp","confidence":"high","docstring":"Computes and stores the RF TX power temperature compensation value, clamps negative compensation, updates GPIO configuration, logs the change, and either disables compensation or schedules the next periodic update.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"p_temp_comp_state","v1":"temp_base_code","v2":"temp_comp_value","v4":"now_tick"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":5,"meaning":"stored temperature/base calibration byte"},{"offset":7,"meaning":"current TX power temperature compensation value"},{"offset":11,"meaning":"temperature compensation disabled flag byte"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"timer/deadline field passed to scheduler"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"16-bit periodic update interval scaled by 30000 ticks"}]}
